name: Square Payment Forms for WordPress – Square Integration – MyPayKit
author: SeedProd

sections.description:
Hey there! 👋

Integrating Square with WordPress shouldn’t be complicated. That’s why we built MyPayKit Payment Forms for Square – a powerful yet simple WordPress plugin that helps you collect Square payments smoothly.

We’ve seen firsthand how many small businesses struggle with clunky payment forms that frustrate customers and lead to abandoned carts. Our Square payment solution changes that!

🚨 Why Square payment forms matter for your business:
When customers have a seamless Square payment experience, they’re much more likely to complete their purchase. Professional payment forms build trust and increase conversion rates.

With MyPayKit Payment Forms for Square, you get:
* Secure Square payment processing that customers recognize and trust
* A user-friendly WordPress form builder that helps you create great-looking payment forms quickly
* Simple WordPress-Square integration without technical headaches
* Support for multiple payment methods including credit cards and digital wallets

💎 What makes our Square WordPress integration different:

  • 🔄 Simple Square Integration – Connect your Square account in seconds and start accepting payments right away
  • 📝 Conversion-Optimized Payment Forms – Templates designed to increase conversions and guide customers smoothly through checkout
  • 📱 Fully Responsive Forms – Square payment forms look great and function perfectly on phones, tablets, and desktops
  • 🔒 Enterprise-Grade Security – Keep your customers’ payment information safe with Square’s secure processing
  • ⚡ 5-Minute Setup – Get your WordPress Square integration up and running in minutes, even if you’re not tech-savvy
  • 🧩 WordPress Block Editor Integration – Add Square payment forms anywhere on your WordPress site with no coding required
  • 💵 Multiple Payment Options – Accept credit cards, digital wallets, and more through Square’s payment system

Start accepting Square payments on WordPress today with MyPayKit Payment Forms for Square!

When to use MyPayKit Square Payment Forms

  • ✓ Online Stores – Sell products and services with professional Square payment forms
  • ✓ Donation Collections – Create donation forms that process payments through Square
  • ✓ Service Bookings – Accept deposits and payments for appointments and services
  • ✓ Event Registrations – Sell tickets and collect registrations with Square integration
  • ✓ Membership Sites – Process Square payments for membership access

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • MyPayKit account (free to create)
  • Square account

External services

This plugin connects to the MyPayKit API (https://mypaykit.com/api/v1) to manage payment forms and process Square payments. Here is a detailed breakdown of the external service usage:

MyPayKit API

  • What it is: A service that manages Square payment forms and facilitates payment processing.

  • When data is sent:

    1. When connecting your WordPress site to your MyPayKit account via OAuth
    2. When fetching your available payment forms for display in the WordPress admin
    3. When creating, editing, or deleting payment forms
    4. When rendering payment forms on your website (through embedded iframes)

  • What data is sent:

    1. Site authentication tokens (site_token and mypaykit_token) for secure API communication
    2. Form IDs when requesting specific form data
    3. Admin email address during initial account connection (only with user consent)
    4. Website visitor data is sent directly to MyPayKit via the embedded iframe when they view or submit a payment form

  • Who provides this service: SeedProd, LLC (“MyPayKit”)

  • Legal information: Terms of Use, Privacy Policy

Square Payment Processing

  • What it is: Payment processing services accessed through MyPayKit.
  • When/how it’s used: When website visitors submit payment information through the embedded MyPayKit form. Payment data is sent directly from the visitor’s browser to Square via the MyPayKit form iframe – your WordPress site never receives or processes the payment information.
  • Legal information: Square Terms of Service, Square Privacy Policy

Support

For support, please visit mypaykit.com/support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘MyPayKit’ in your admin menu.
  4. Click ‘Connect MyPayKit Account’ to link your account.
  5. Start creating and embedding payment forms!
sections.faq:
How do I integrate Square with WordPress?

MyPayKit makes Square WordPress integration simple:
1. Install and activate MyPayKit Payment Forms for Square
2. Connect your Square account with our OAuth integration
3. Create your first payment form
4. Add the form to any page using our block or shortcode

Do I need a MyPayKit account?

Yes, you need a MyPayKit account to use this plugin. You can create one for free at mypaykit.com.

Do I need a Square account?

Yes, since MyPayKit uses Square for payment processing, you’ll need a Square account connected to your MyPayKit account.

How do I add a Square payment form to my WordPress page?

You can add Square payment forms using either:
1. The MyPayKit Forms block in the WordPress block editor
2. The [mypaykit_form id=”form_id”] shortcode in the classic editor

Is Square payment processing secure?

Yes! All payment processing is handled securely through Square’s payment infrastructure with PCI compliance. Your WordPress site never directly handles sensitive payment data.

What payment methods can I accept with MyPayKit Square integration?

MyPayKit allows you to accept all payment methods supported by Square, including credit cards, debit cards, and digital wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay.

Can I customize how my Square payment forms look?

Yes! MyPayKit offers extensive customization options for your payment forms, allowing you to match your brand colors and style.
